test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

I will help you in submitting the assignment.

options.text: You will help by me in submitting the assignment.
In submitting the assignment, I will be helped by you.
In submitting the assignment, you would be helped by me.
You will be helped by me in submitting the assignment.

solution:
The correct answer is **"You will be helped by me in submitting the assignment."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Future Tense and in Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Future Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
 
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + will + V1 + object (Active Voice__)
 
• Object + will + be + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha will sing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• *A song will be sung by Esha.​ *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• In passive voice, the object **(you)** becomes the subject, and the subject** (I) **becomes the object.
 
• The helping verb **"will" **changes to** "will be"** in the passive voice.
 
• The main verb **"help" **changes to **"helped"** in the passive voice.
 
• - The preposition **"in" **remains the same.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
